result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility and styling issue where white text on the promotional banner has severely insufficient contrast against its light mint background.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is rendered in white against a pale mint green background, resulting in extremely poor color contrast and making the promo code nearly unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner heading and subtitle text to a dark color (such as dark green or charcoal) or darken the banner's background color to meet WCAG contrast requirements.
